references.text: The burnt offering shall be a flawless bull, which gives a pleasing aroma to the Lord
Instructions for the burnt offering on the first day of the seventh month (the Feast of Trumpets)
The pleasing aroma (ריח ניחח) that rises up to the Lord from an offering
Burnt offering as a pleasing aroma to the Lord, a fire offering
Similar offering requirements with bull, ram, and lamb at the New Moon festival
The same type of burnt offering with bulls, rams, and lambs during the Passover feast
Burnt offerings for a pleasing aroma at the Feast of Weeks with the same animals
Ezekiel's vision of future burnt offerings with bull, ram, and lamb without defect
The repeated sacrifices in the old covenant point forward to Christ's perfect sacrifice
